audit.whatIsWrong: diff is FAVOURED at 3/10 and report[14] claims 54.9%, but the packet has 49.35% over 310 games.
audit.why: A player told the lane is a 3/10 free win plays it loosely, and this matchup is decided by a late-game flip that punishes exactly that.
audit.corrected: diff EVEN, diffRating 5/10, tone recoloured, and both prose statements restated at 49.35%.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3] credits Highlander at levels 4-5; Highlander is the ultimate and does not exist before level 6.
audit.why: It advertises a spike two levels early, which is the kind of thing that gets a player killed taking an all-in he cannot back up.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5 now rest on Wuju Style true damage and Meditate; Highlander moved entirely into the level-6 line.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing stated that Highlander makes Yi immune to slowing effects, which is the decisive interaction against Wither. Siphoning Strike's auto reset was also never named as the wind-up tell.
audit.why: Wither is Nasus's only tool that turns off Yi's DPS; knowing R blanks it decides when Yi commits. The Q reset means the tell is the wind-up, not a cast animation.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] and whys[4] now state the slow immunity (matching the mirror's finding on the Nasus side); spikes[0] and early name the auto reset.
sources: ownerKit R 'immune to all slowing effects'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns carried Wither only, and no Q numbers.
audit.why: Siphoning Strike falling from 7.5s to 3.5s is why extended trades get worse as he ranks it.

edits.before: Highlander plus Alpha Strike lets you all-in through his single Wither around levels 4-5.
edits.after: At 4-5 Wuju Style true damage and Meditate beat his rank-1 Q, but Wither still ends chases.

edits.before: At level 6 your ult all-in beats his sustain before Wither can fully stack.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander's slow immunity blanks Wither entirely while the ult runs.

edits.before: Once you have Q, E, and W you out-trade Nasus cleanly: Alpha Strike in, flick on Wuju Style true damage, and Meditate through his Siphoning Strike hits so his sustain can't keep pace.
edits.after: Once you have Q, E, and W you out-trade Nasus cleanly: his combo opens with a Siphoning Strike auto reset, so step in as he winds it up on a minion, burn Wuju Style true damage, and Meditate the chip back.

edits.before: Highlander turns any all-in decisive; his only answer is Wither, so bait it or run him down before he can slow you to zero attack speed.
edits.after: Highlander grants slow immunity, so Wither does nothing while it runs — all-in with R up, or bait the 15s Wither and commit once it is down.

edits.before: Level 1 Nasus can Q your Alpha Strike animation and his early sustain plus tankiness makes a raw trade unappealing, so respect his lane presence before you have E.
edits.after: Level 1 his Siphoning Strike is an auto reset on 7.5s and Soul Eater lifesteal refunds the chip you deal, so the wind-up is your cue to step back until Wuju Style (E) is online.

edits.before: Track W Wither (around 15s at rank 1) — it's his only kiting/peel tool and his entire gank setup; if it's down you can all-in freely, and you should bait it before committing Alpha Strike.
edits.after: Track Wither — 15s at rank 1, his only peel and his whole gank setup; when it's down you can all-in freely, and Highlander blanks it outright. Siphoning Strike falls from 7.5s to 3.5s, so late-rank resets land every trade.

edits.before: It's a low-difficulty 3/10 because your scaling outpaces his stacking timeline and Alpha Strike answers his only disruptive tool (W) — the only way to lose is to AFK-farm and let him reach his stack power spike.
edits.after: It's a 5/10 and the win rate sits at 49.35%: your item timeline outpaces his stacking and Alpha Strike answers his only disruptive tool (W), but any game that runs long hands him a stack spike you cannot out-DPS.

edits.before: FAVOURED, 54.9% — a 3/10 lane Yi wins by denying stacks and spiking first, losing only the ultra-late window to a free-farmed Nasus.
edits.after: EVEN, 49.35% — a 5/10 lane Yi wins by denying stacks and spiking first, and loses the ultra-late window to a free-farmed Nasus.

notes: Level chart already matches the packet chart in both layers; no chart edits needed. Highlander's slow immunity is stated the same way here as on the Nasus side's audit, so the mirror agrees.
